# jochwacht-sbom 0.13.0 — the bill carries the new namespace

Generated bills now use `jochwacht:` properties instead of `jochwacht:`
(`jochwacht:ecosystem`, `jochwacht:detected-by`, `jochwacht:condition`),
and the files you write are read under both spellings:

| You have | Also works |
|---|---|
| `.jochwachtignore` | `.jochwachtignore` (still read) |
| `jochwacht-deps.yaml` | `jochwacht-deps.yaml` (still read) |
| `jochwacht.yaml` | `jochwacht.yaml` (still read) |

The new spelling wins when both exist. Nothing you have stops working, and
nothing needs renaming.

**Why the old names stay readable for good:** these files sit in your
repository, and bills generated from them are kept for ten years under the
CRA. A reader that forgot the old namespace would treat last month's bill
as a stranger's file.

The suite reads both namespaces from the same release, so a bill written by
either tool is understood by the other.
